claims.evidence: Photo 0 and Photo 1 both show a unit branded 'BLUE GATE' consistent with a UPS form factor; no functional or capacity claim is made beyond naming the item.

risks.risk: VA/Wattage capacity unknown, which drives most of the value
risks.proof: Clear photo of the rating label/sticker on the back or bottom of the unit showing VA/W output
risks.if_unproven: price at the lowest common capacity tier for this brand/form factor

risks.risk: Battery health/age and runtime not demonstrated
risks.proof: Video of unit running on battery alone (unplugged) for at least a minute with a load attached
risks.if_unproven: price as battery likely dead or near end-of-life, needing replacement

risks.risk: Whether unit powers on at all
risks.proof: Video of plugging in and powering on, showing indicator lights sequence

risks.risk: Output sockets/ports condition and count not visible
risks.proof: Close-up photo of the rear panel showing all output sockets
risks.if_unproven: price assuming only one working socket or damaged sockets

risks.proof: Photo of model/serial sticker or original purchase receipt

risks.risk: No original box or accessories confirmed
risks.proof: Photo showing box, manual, or additional cables if present

proof_requests: Close-up photo of the rating/serial label showing VA/Wattage and model number
Video of the UPS powering on and running briefly on battery after unplugging
Close-up photo of the rear panel output sockets
Photo of any box, manual, or accessories included
response.reason: The witness confirms this is a Blue Gate brand UPS, so it can be priced at worst case given unverified capacity, battery health, and functionality, with clear proof paths to raise the price.
